SUBJECT: Inauguration Ceremony of the
Communal Steam Kitchen for
Jewish Refugees at 961 East
Seward Road.

At 10 a.m. on the 15th of November, 1942, the
inauguration ceremony of the "Communal Steam Kitchen"
at 961 East Seward Road, Refugee Camp, for the destitute
Jewish Refugees from Central Europe was held, which was
organized by the "Kitchen Fund" and "Centrjewcom"
organizations together. The full capacity of the kitchen
is 6,000 meals at one time.

The occasion was attended by about 200 persons
consisting of prominent Russian Jews and Jewish Refugees
from Central Europe.

The ceremony was also attended through invitation
by Mr. Kubota and Mr. Sekiya from the Imperial Japanese
Naval Authorities and Mrs. Nogami.

Dr. Bergglas, Chairman of the "Kitchen Fund". and
L.M. Rogovin, Chairman of the "Centrjewcom" presided.
The opening was made by a cantor, who sang a hymn in
the Jiddish language, which was followed by a short
speech from a rabbi in the German language, citing the
Jewish Problem in general and in Shanghai.

Further short speeches were made by the following:-
1) Dr. Bergglass, who welcomed the representatives of
the Japanese Authorities and other persons attending
the ceremony, thanking all for the attendance. He
informed the assembly that from the 15th of November
the "Kitchen Fund" is able to feed 3,000 refugees.

主题：西华德路（Seward Road）东段961号
犹太难民公共蒸汽食堂
落成典礼。

1942年11月15日上午10时，位于难民营西华德路东段961号、专为来自中欧的贫困犹太难民设立的“公共蒸汽食堂”举行了落成典礼，该活动由“食堂基金”（Kitchen Fund）和“Centrjewcom”组织共同举办。该食堂的最大供餐能力为每次6,000份。

约有200人出席了此次盛会，其中包括显赫的俄罗斯犹太人和来自中欧的犹太难民。

日本帝国海军当局的久保田（Kubota）先生和关谷（Sekiya）先生以及野上（Nogami）夫人也应邀出席了典礼。

“食堂基金”主席伯格拉斯（Bergglas）博士和“Centrjewcom”主席罗戈文（L.M. Rogovin）主持了典礼。开场由一位领唱者用意第绪语（Jiddish）演唱了一首赞美诗，随后一位拉比用德语发表了简短演讲，引用了普遍意义上的以及上海的犹太人问题。

随后，以下人士发表了简短演讲：
1) 伯格格拉斯（Bergglass）博士，他欢迎日本当局代表及其他出席典礼的人士，感谢所有人的光临。他向与会者通报，自11月15日起，“食堂基金”能够为3,000名难民提供膳食。

2) Dr. Silberstein, member of the "Kuratorium of the
Kitchen Fund", gave a short outline of the founda-
tion and activity of the "Kitchen Fund" and a short
account of the Jewish Emigration into Shanghai.

3) L.M. Rogovin, mentioned above, outlined the founding
and activity of the "Centrjewcom", in the short period
of its existence, and that the organization had under-
taken the care of over 600 children.

4) Mr. Kubota then made a short speech in the Japanese
language, which was interpreted in English by Dr.
Cohn as follows;

"That the Japanese Authorities are glad to hear of
the well organized support to the destitute refugees,
rendered by the Jewish Charity Organizations in
Shanghai, that the Japanese Government could not
render any monetary assistance for this purpose,
being for five years in a state of war with China
and now also in war with other countries, that he
wishes the unemployed refugees to obtain employment,
so that they would not be in need of help from
Charity organisations."

The speech of Mr. Kubota was met with great
enthusiasm by the persons present.

The key to the Communal Kitchen was then sold by
"American Auction", officiated by A. Beerbrayer, member
of "Centrjewcom", and was sold for $25,000 to I. Kahan,
Latvian Jew, Committee member of the Ashkenazi Jewish
Communal Association, being the last bidder in the auction
offering $5,000.00.

2) “食堂基金管理委员会”（Kuratorium of the Kitchen Fund）成员西尔伯斯坦（Silberstein）博士，简要概述了“食堂基金”的成立和活动，并简述了犹太人移民上海的情况。

3) 前述的罗戈文（L.M. Rogovin），概述了“Centrjewcom”在其短暂存在期间的成立和活动，并指出该组织已承担起照顾600多名儿童的工作。

4) 随后，久保田（Kubota）先生用日语发表了简短演讲，由科恩（Cohn）博士翻译如下：

“日本当局很高兴听到上海的犹太慈善组织对贫困难民提供了组织良好的援助；日本政府无法为此目的提供任何金钱援助，因为日本已与中国处于战争状态五年，目前也与其他国家处于战争状态；他希望失业的难民能够获得就业，从而不再需要慈善组织的帮助。”

久保田先生的演讲受到了在场人士的热烈欢迎。

随后，公共食堂的钥匙通过“美式拍卖”出售，由“Centrjewcom”成员比尔布雷耶（A. Beerbrayer）主持拍卖，最终以25,000美元的价格卖给了伊·卡汉（I. Kahan），他是一名拉脱维亚犹太人，阿什肯纳兹犹太社区协会委员会成员，是拍卖中出价5,000.00美元的最后一位竞拍者。

I. Kahan presented the key to Mr. Kubota and asked
him to open the kitchen door. This offer was accepted
by Mr. Kubota and all persons present then proceeded
to the kitchen door where again a short prayer in
jiddish was made by the attending rabbi and Mr. Kubota
then unlocked the kitchen door, all entered and a
general inspection was made of the 14 large kettles,
in which the food is cooked by steam from a boiler in the
adjoining room.

All were offered to test the food. During the test
of the food the auctioneer A. Beerbrayer put up for
sale the 14 kettles on which name plates of honorable
guests would be affixed.

The 14 kettles were sold for approximately $18,000
ranging from $500 to $3,100 each. Three of these kettles
were sold to I. Yanovics, Russian Jew, member of the
Jewish Chamber of Commerce, who offered that on one
of the kettles would be engraved the name of Mr. Kubato,
on another the name of Mr. Sekiya and on the third
"Jewish Youth".

The above was accepted.

One of the kettles will bear the name of Mrs. Nogami,
who came together with Mr. Kubota.

Four "messuses", small metal containers with a
inscription in Hebrew (every Jewish home should have
one on the outer side of their house door), were also
sold by auction for the total of $3,400.00. The total
sum of $45,000 to $50,000 was collected from the auction;
the exact total amount will be ascertained later.

伊·卡汉（I. Kahan）将钥匙呈交给久保田（Kubota）先生，并请他打开食堂大门。久保田先生接受了这一提议，所有在场人员随即前往食堂门口，出席的拉比再次用意第绪语做了简短祈祷，随后久保田先生打开了食堂门锁，众人进入，并对14个大锅进行了全面检查，食物由相邻房间锅炉产生的蒸汽烹煮。

邀请所有人品尝食物。在试吃期间，拍卖师比尔布雷耶（A. Beerbrayer）将这14口锅拿出来拍卖，锅上将附上贵宾的名牌。

这14口锅以每口500美元至3,100美元不等的价格售出，总额约为18,000美元。其中三口锅卖给了俄罗斯犹太人、犹太商会成员伊·亚诺维茨（I. Yanovics），他提出在其中一口锅上刻上久保田（Kubato）先生的名字，另一口刻上关谷（Sekiya）先生的名字，第三口刻上“犹太青年”。

上述提议被接受。

其中一口锅将刻上与久保田先生一同前来的野上（Nogami）夫人的名字。

四个“门柱圣卷盒”（messuses），即带有希伯来文铭文的小型金属容器（每个犹太家庭都应在其房屋大门外侧拥有一个），也通过拍卖售出，总金额为3,400.00美元。拍卖共筹集了45,000至50,000美元；确切总金额稍后核实。

SUBJECT: Application for Permission to hold a General Meeting of all Supporters of the "EASTJEWCOM" on Dec. 6th., 1942.

With reference to the attached application by "Eastjewcom" (Committee for the Assistance to Jewish Refugees from Eastern Europe) to hold a General Meeting of all Supporters of the Organization at 4 p.m. on Dec. 6th. 1942, at the Shanghai Jewish Club, 722 B'Well Road, it can be stated that the main purpose for the meeting will be the election of a new Executive Committee and the meeting will be attended by 200 to 300 persons.

The Organization was founded in March 1941 for the purpose of rendering assistance to the Jewish Refugees from Poland, Lithuania, Latvia and Estonia and since then had no changes in the membership of the Executive Committee.

At present a certain dissatisfaction has been expressed by the recently founded "Centrjewcom" (Ashkenazi Committee for the Assistance to Jewish Refugees from Central Europe) and the members of the "Kuratorium of the Kitchen Fund" for unwilling cooperation of the existing Executive Committee of the "Eastjewcom", therefore the general meeting and election was found to be necessary

The Organization is registered with the S.M.Police and there appears to be no objection in granting the requisite permission for the meeting, which is of great importance to the Russian Jewish Community in general.

The applicant for the permission is A. Oppenheim, Chairman of the Organization, Lithuanian Jew, No. 330 Szechuen Road.

主题：关于申请许可于1942年12月6日举行“EASTJEWCOM”全体支持者大会。

鉴于附件中“Eastjewcom”（东欧犹太难民援助委员会）提交的申请，拟于1942年12月6日下午4时在静安寺路（B'Well Road）722号上海犹太俱乐部举行该组织全体支持者大会，据悉，会议的主要目的是选举新的执行委员会，预计将有200至300人出席。

该组织成立于1941年3月，旨在为来自波兰、立陶宛、拉脱维亚和爱沙尼亚的犹太难民提供援助，此后执行委员会成员未发生变动。

目前，新成立的“Centrjewcom”（中欧阿什肯纳兹犹太难民援助委员会）和“食堂基金管理委员会”成员对现有“Eastjewcom”执行委员会的不合作表示了一定程度的不满，因此认为有必要召开大会并进行选举。

该组织已在上海公共租界警务处注册，批准此次会议所需的许可似乎没有异议，这对整个俄罗斯犹太社区至关重要。

SUBJECT: European Jewish Refugees -
Premises leased from SMC

With reference to the attached minutes of the
Coordinating Committee, it can be stated that the Kitchen
Fund - Kuratorium has now received a letter from the
S.M.C. informing that the rental as stated in the
minutes shall be collected for the Alcock Road Barracks
$1500 per mensem and $1800 per mensem for the Primary
School for Chinese, Wayside Road, as from the 1st. of
November, 1942.

The above was disclosed during an interview with
Dr. Berglass, Chairman of the Kitchen Fund Kuratorium
in the presence of other members of the same organization,
who stated that in view of the fact that the S.M.C. was
so kind as to assist the Jewish refugees through contri-
buting $20,000 per mensem for supporting the Refugee
Camps, which sum has been also received for the month
of October, the above letter came as a big surprise and
will be of grave consequence to the refugees, because in
view of the insufficient money for supporting the Camps,
the balance will have to be covered from the money
collected for feeding the refugees and that it rather
looks like that the S.M.C. is contributing to the
refugee problem with one hand and taking away with the
other and that the "Kuratorium" will request the S.M.C.
to withdraw the decision and intend to send delegates
to the Chairman or Secretary of the S.M.C. to discuss
the matter.

Officer in charge Foreign Affairs,
Crime & Special Branch.

主题：欧洲犹太难民 -
向工部局租赁的房产

鉴于附件中的协调委员会会议纪要，据悉，“食堂基金管理委员会”（Kitchen Fund - Kuratorium）现已收到工部局（S.M.C.）的来信，通知称正如纪要所述，自1942年11月1日起，将收取阿尔科克路（Alcock Road）兵营每月1,500美元以及韦思德路（Wayside Road）华童公学每月1,800美元的租金。

上述情况是在与“食堂基金管理委员会”主席伯格拉斯（Berglass）博士面谈时披露的，当时该组织其他成员也在场。他们表示，鉴于工部局慷慨协助犹太难民，每月捐款20,000美元用于支持难民营，且10月份的款项也已收到，因此上述来信令人非常意外，并将给难民带来严重后果。因为鉴于支持难民营的资金不足，差额将不得不从筹集的难民伙食费中填补，这看起来像是工部局一手在贡献于解决难民问题，另一手却在收回资金。“管理委员会”将请求工部局撤回该决定，并打算派遣代表与工部局主席或秘书讨论此事。

CONFIDENTIAL

Extract from the Minutes of the Coordinating
Committee held on Friday, September 25, 1942.

European Jewish Refugees.- Premises leased from Council.

With regard to the occupation by the European Jewish Refugees
of the Council's premises, Alcock Road Barracks and the Primary
School for Chinese, Wayside Road, Mr. Teraoka states that on
July 10 this Committee decided that the Committee for the
Assistance of European Jewish Refugees was to be informed that
they would be permitted to occupy these premises for three months
at a nominal rental, after which they would be charged an
economic rental. The Public Works Department report that an
economic rental for the Alcock Road Barracks would be $1,500
per mensem and $1,800 per mensem for the Primary School for
Chinese, Wayside Road. It is

DECIDED that as from November 1, the Council is to
charge the Committee for the Assistance of European Jewish
Refugees a rental of $1,500 per mensem for the Alcock Road
Barracks and $1,800 per mensem for the Primary School for
Chinese, Wayside Road.

Certified true copy.

SUBJECT: Committee for the Assistance of European Jewish Refugees in Shanghai Stops Payment of Subsidies to Destitute Jewish Refugees. - 7000 Refugees faced with Uncertain Future Here.

It is learned that on May 21, 1942, the Committee for the Assistance of European Jewish Refugees in Shanghai has received from the Jewish Committee at La Paz (Bolivia) a cable stating that it will no longer be able to act as an intermediary between the Shanghai Committee and the Joint Distribution Committee of America, as the U. S. State Department prohibits such a connection.

The Committee is now faced with a position similar to that prevailing in January 1942, when, however, through the kindness of the local Japanese Authorities contact through South America was established with the Joint Distribution of America, which guaranteed to refund a sum of US$180,000 raised locally from Jewish circles and used for the relief of destitute Jews.

Since the beginning of April the local Committee has attempted to insure a guarantee from the Joint for further monies, in order to be able to carry on the relief programme for further six months. The above mentioned cable has for the time being excluded all possibilities of raising the required monies.

In view of this recent development the Committee has been forced to stop the out-payment of subsidies to destitute refugees. A certain amount of vegetables and bread stocked by the Committee is still being distributed, but it is thought that the supplies will be exhausted within a month or less.

PROCLAMATION

TO ALL JEWISH MEN AND WOMEN IN SHANGHAI.

In this serious hour the "JUEDISCHE GEMEINDE" issues an
appeal for help to you. A terrible calamity has reached a great
number of the Immigrants. The public has already been notified
that the help from the Joint in America has at present ceased.
Hunger and disease threaten many of our brothers and sisters.
Everything must be done to come to their aid as quickly as possible.
We therefore request all Jews to declare their solidarity with the
sufferers. To bring immediate aid the Juedische Gemeinde requests:
1. Every family which does its own cooking shall daily give one
main meal to at least one needy person.
2. Families which do not do their own cooking shall pay a sum
of $30.00 (thirty) monthly instead.
3. Restaurant, Coffee-House, and Bar owners shall charge a
10% surtax on all bills, which shall go to the assistance fund of
the Juedische Gemeinde.
4. Provisionstores shall also collect a 5% surtax on their goods.
5. It is the duty of every wealthy Jew to come to the immediate
assistance of his fellow-Jews by contributing a generous sum.
All those to whom this proclamation applies are requested
to get in touch personally, by letter or by phone with the
Juedische Gemeinde (805 East Seward Road, Tel. 50192) without any
loss of time.

COMMITTEE OF REPRESENTATIVES OF THE
JUEDISCHE GEMEINDE.

Shanghai, January 11, 1942.

THE ABOVE PROCLAMATION IS PUBLISHED WITH THE KNOWLEDGE
AND AGREEMENT OF THE JOINT REPRESENTATIVES.

公告

致上海全体犹太男女。

在这严峻时刻，“犹太社区”（JUEDISCHE GEMEINDE）向你们发出求助呼吁。一场可怕的灾难已降临到大量移民身上。公众已获知，来自美国联合委员会（Joint）的援助目前已停止。饥饿和疾病威胁着我们的许多兄弟姐妹。必须尽一切努力尽快向他们提供援助。因此，我们请求所有犹太人声明与受苦者团结一致。为了提供即时援助，犹太社区请求：
1. 每个自行做饭的家庭应每天至少向一名 needy person（贫困者）提供一顿主食。
2. 不自行做饭的家庭应改为每月支付30.00美元（三十元）。
3. 餐馆、咖啡馆和酒吧老板应在所有账单上加收10%的附加税，款项归入犹太社区的援助基金。
4. 食品店也应对其商品收取5%的附加税。
5. 每位富有的犹太人都有责任通过捐赠慷慨的款项，立即援助其犹太同胞。
所有适用本公告的人士，请务必毫不拖延地亲自、通过信件或电话与犹太社区联系（地址：西华德路805号，电话：50192）。

犹太社区代表委员会。

上海，1942年1月11日。

上述公告的发布已获联合委员会代表的知晓和同意。
